issues.problem: The sofa sits diagonally in front of the two floor plants rather than between them, contrary to the hard placement constraint.
issues.fix: Reposition and straighten the sofa so it is flanked by obj_0006 and obj_0017, with its centre approximately aligned with the plants.

issues.problem: Both armchairs are separated from the coffee table by a large expanse of floor, leaving their occupants unable to use it comfortably and making the seating group feel disconnected.
issues.fix: Bring the armchairs closer to the coffee table and angle them into the seating group, leaving comfortable circulation space.

issues.problem: The coffee table is densely covered with books, magazines, cups and candles arranged across almost its entire surface. There is little usable space to set down a drink or handle the reading material without disturbing other items.
issues.fix: Relocate some books and magazines to shelving and reduce or regroup the candles, leaving a substantial clear area within reach of the seating. Keep obj_0013 on the coffee table as required.
